keyLimits.en: One license covers 2 computers (Windows x64 and/or macOS universal). No cross-platform purchases with mobile.
Purchased separately per app store (App Store, Google Play, Huawei AppGallery); desktop key does not unlock mobile.

cautions.en: No cross-platform license sharing: desktop and each mobile store purchase are billed separately, so a user on both iPad and desktop pays twice.

capabilities.en: Full 3D sculpting and painting toolset (multires sculpting, dynamic tessellation, PBR materials).
Cloud-based license activation with offline use for up to 15 days without reverification.
Multi-seat and classroom licensing with command-line activation for lab deployment.

limitations.en: An activation is tied to a specific computer, not an account; reformatting or replacing a machine consumes a new activation.
No educational discounts except through Apple School Manager on iOS; purchase orders not accepted.

reason.en: The dominant professional 3D sculpting tool that Nomad Sculpt is commonly positioned as an affordable, mobile-friendly alternative to.
Free, general-purpose 3D suite that includes sculpting tools covering an overlapping use case.

unknowns: Exact current mobile price could vary slightly by app store/region; only the figure shown on the official site was captured.
